title: ==SR ENGINEER I — GAME TESTING==  ·  ONLINE & MOBILE PLATFORMS

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA engineer with **4.8 years** of experience, including **game testing** for online and mobile platforms. Led test planning and execution for web/mobile modules at Chetu; executed functional, regression, and UAT cycles for **payment and gaming** domains at Coracle — validating game portals, payout logic, and transaction flows. **2 years of automation experience** (Playwright, Selenium BDD) as a plus for this role, with strong communication and attention to detail.
